properties.site-address: Oxpens Road, Oxford, (Oxpens Road West End Site)
properties.notes: The City Council has adopted the Oxpens SPD to guide development on this site. The Site is also allocated in the emerging Local Plan 2036 which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings). The local plan expects a minimum of 450 homes to be delivered on this site.
